Author: @dshuppert
Content:
People will never learn... Eye-witnesses/people are lowest form of "proof" (they aren't actually proof). Being a good actor/actress is very little help in most cases. All other forms of evidence are taken into consideration as a higher priority in an investigation. The news makes a big deal of eye-witnesses, but actual investigators understand that even well intentioned witnesses are lousy information sources. They aren't useless, obviously. But every human alive knows that people can lie, can be lousy at describing things, or even not understand what they saw (that's all ignoring bias, which every human has).

That said, witnesses are taken into account before the rest of the investigation can be conducted. They are used for the 'initial response'.
